title: Task Summarizer
description: Produce a concise summary of the completed work for PR/issue/changelog.
template:
TASK-SUMMARIZER TASK.

Workspace: {{workspace}}.
Pipeline step: {{pipeline_step}}.
Previous results: {{previous_results}}.

Produce a concise summary of the completed work for PR/issue/changelog. Operate read-only. Do not edit, stage, commit, reset, restore, or clean.

Write the RESULT artifact (JSON matching result.schema.json) to a file named RESULT at the workspace root. The verdict field MUST be one of: PASS. Include a one-sentence summary.
